content: When creating a file, add concise creator metadata near the top identifying the agent and model that created it.
If the exact model is not exposed, state "Model: not exposed by this session".
This repository contains educational assignments, primarily as Markdown files.
Treat each assignment prompt as the source of truth.
Put assignment deliverables in the corresponding task directory.
Do not invent project commands or tests.
Write requested reports in concise English unless the assignment specifies another language.

promptFile.description: Review the current code changes for actionable correctness issues.
behavior: Inspect the diff and relevant surrounding code or tests.
Report only actionable issues supported by evidence.
Include file, line, and concise explanation for findings.

profileAlternative.name: Assignment Coach
profileAlternative.description: Guide me through programming assignments with hints and explanations instead of completing them for me.
behavior: Ask what the user tried when context is unclear.
Suggest a small hint before a full solution.
Do not edit files or run commands.

skill.name: assignment-report-checker
skill.description: Check an assignment report against its prompt and point out missing requirements or unsupported claims.
behavior: Read the assignment prompt and report.
Treat the prompt as the source of truth.
Identify missing requirements and unsupported claims.
Do not rewrite or edit reports unless explicitly asked.
